title: The salty emission of the intermediate-mass AGB star OH 30.1-0.7
question: What is the complete molecular inventory and circumstellar structure of the intermediate-mass AGB star OH 30.1-0.7, and what does its circumstellar chemistry reveal about a potential binary companion and mass-loss history?

recipe.goal: Reconstitute calibrated visibilities, self-calibrate, and image continuum and line cubes
recipe.method: Download standard ALMA archive products, reconstitute calibrated Measurement Sets, split spectral windows adjusted to constant LSR velocity, identify line-free channels, image continuum for self-calibration, combine Band 6 configurations with equal weight, and produce continuum-subtracted spectral cubes.
key_parameters: Equal weighting of extended and compact Band 6 configurations

recipe.goal: Measure continuum astrometry, angular extents, and spectral indices
recipe.method: Fit a 2D Gaussian to continuum peaks using CASA imfit, measure angular extents of 3-sigma and 5-sigma contours, and compute spectral indices between Band 3 (convolved to match Band 6 compact beam) and Band 6 compact continuum at 107.86 and 236.02 GHz.
key_parameters: Band 3 centre frequency = 107.86 GHz, Band 6 centre frequency = 236.02 GHz, 7% flux scale uncertainty per band
assumptions: Distance = 3900 +- 800 pc and negligible proper motion between epochs

recipe.goal: Extract aperture spectra, identify molecular lines, and construct zeroth moment maps
recipe.method: Extract spectra in circular apertures of varying radii (0.3" to 8") centred on the stellar continuum peak, construct zeroth moment maps over channels with emission >3 sigma plus 1-2 channels on either side, and assign molecular carriers using CDMS.
key_parameters: Detection threshold >= 3 sigma in spectrum and/or zeroth moment map

recipe.goal: Fit line profiles to measure central velocities, line widths, systemic velocity, expansion velocity, and integrated fluxes
recipe.method: Fit a soft parabola profile to unblended lines to obtain central velocity and line width, integrate line fluxes over a velocity range a few km/s wider than the fitted width, average central velocities for systemic velocity, and measure full CO expansion velocity from >30 sigma detections in channel maps.
key_parameters: Free parameters of soft parabola: F_0, v_cent, v_w, gamma

recipe.goal: Estimate molecular excitation temperatures, column densities, radial temperature profile, and mass-loss timescale
recipe.method: Compare detected/undetected SO2 lines with CDMS relative intensities at different temperatures, fit linear population diagrams for Na35Cl and K35Cl, derive power-law radial temperature profile, and calculate dynamical age and photodissociation mass-loss limit from CO outer radius and expansion velocity.
assumptions: Power-law radial temperature profile T(r) = T_*(r/R_*)^-epsilon; constant expansion velocity of 23 km/s at distance 3.9 kpc
